new_findings.title: Group-12 cleanup restores the old session child-list root after adding real children
new_findings.evidence: env_wide_case saves the complete session before env_wide_body creates sound entities. Cleanup calls env_restore_state, which memcpy-restores that entire pre-creation record. The record includes special_effect_root. The real constructor inserts each new entity at the head and changes the old first child predecessor. Restoring only the old root detaches the newly allocated head prefix while leaving entity links and other lists modified.
new_findings.impact: After a successful 16-child case, the next case sees the original terrain-child count instead of 16; its created count violates the 16-to-17 continuity guard. The old first child also retains a predecessor inconsistent with the restored root. Process isolation does not repair topology within the three-case process. The BF red run stopped fatally at 17 before its cleanup and therefore did not expose this successful-return defect. No 16/17/20 healthy witness can be accepted from this source.
new_findings.requested_change: Preserve the post-construction child topology while restoring the intended scalar/field/global session state on every returning path. Keep newly created children reachable and internally linked. Validate retained identities/counts and root/predecessor/successor/parent continuity after cleanup and into the next case. Correct only the fixture, then run the finite real 16/17/20 witness. Align the new Rust header and test naming with the actual altitude-140, half-amplitude setup rather than stale altitude-zero/unchanged-amplitude prose.

This corrects the prior harness assertion without hiding engine failure.
